question:
Two positions of a dice are shown below. When number ‘one’ is on the top, what number will be at the bottom?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75075df6d48ae037aedade7ecf14553d16668be25f05f2c7dfbce614ee3a3526.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/421ea6349568766f4189191c3c669f295406fa2531980a2bd064dfeb08d5bf0b.png] 

**__Logic__**: When two numbers are common in given faces of the cube.

In that case, the number remaining on the faces will be on the opposite faces of each other.

In this case, "4" and "6" are common.

The left number will be opposite each other.

This means 1 will be opposite to 5 and vice-versa.

So, if "1" is at the top then "5" will be at the bottom.

Hence, the correct answer will be **"Option 1 ".**
